newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Benckiser confirms bourse listing plans.
newsitem.headline: German Benckiser confirms bourse listing plans.

text.p: German cosmetics and chemicals firm Joh A. Benckiser GmbH on Monday confirmed a press report that it planned to split its operations into two divisions and list the units on the New York and Amsterdam stock exchanges.

The Handelsblatt newspaper reported that the company planned to list its cosmetic activities on the New York bourse this spring and the rest of its activities, including cleaners, in Amsterdam, by the end of this year.
Managing director Peter Harf said in response to enquiries the report was correct.

Harf also added that Benckiser had increased its group sales to around 5.3 billion marks ($3.2 billion) from 4.8 billion in 1996, but said he could not comment on earnings because of the strict demands by U.S. bourse supervision authorities.
